purpose: This form is related to the notice of a proposed scheme for the merger or amalgamation of certain companies under section 233 of the Act.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Prepare the notice of the proposed scheme under clause (a) of sub-section (1) of section 233 in Form No. CAA.9.
Issue the notice to invite objections or suggestions from the Registrar, official liquidator, or persons affected.
Issue the notice to the concerned sectoral regulator and respective stock exchanges for regulated or listed companies.
Obtain a certificate from the auditor of the company that the company meets the required conditions if applicable.
File the copy of the approved scheme along with the required auditor certificate in Form No. CAA-10A.
checklist: Verify that the scheme is between eligible classes of companies such as start-up companies, small companies, unlisted companies meeting financial limits, or holding and subsidiary companies.
Check that outstanding loans, debentures, or deposits do not exceed two hundred crore rupees where applicable.
Confirm there is no default in repayment of loans, debentures, or deposits.
Obtain the auditor certificate in Form No. CAA-10A.
Prepare Form No. CAA.9 for the notice.
attachments: Certificate from the auditor of the company in Form No. CAA-10A
watch: Not stated in the Rules text
